description: Gyeran Mari is a beloved Korean rolled omelette, a staple in many Korean households. This fluffy and savory dish is made by rolling thin layers of egg with various fillings, creating a beautiful spiral. It is perfect as a hearty breakfast, a delightful side dish, or a tasty lunchbox item, appealing to both children and adults.

instructions.title: Prepare the Egg Mixture
instructions.text: Crack the eggs into a large bowl. Add the finely diced carrot, chopped green onions, salt, and optional sugar. Whisk vigorously until all ingredients are well combined and the mixture is smooth. Stir in the milk or water for a softer omelette. Ensure no large chunks of egg white remain.

instructions.title: Heat the Pan
instructions.text: Heat a non-stick rectangular or round pan over medium-low heat. Add a small amount of cooking oil and spread it evenly with a paper towel. The pan should be lightly greased, not swimming in oil, to prevent tearing the omelette.

instructions.title: Pour the First Layer
instructions.text: Pour about one-quarter of the egg mixture into the hot pan, tilting to spread it thinly and evenly across the bottom. Let it cook undisturbed until the edges are set and the top is mostly cooked but still slightly wet.

instructions.title: Start Rolling the Omelette
instructions.text: Once the first layer is mostly set, carefully roll the omelette from one end to about two-thirds of the way across the pan, leaving the unrolled portion at the other end. Use a spatula or chopsticks for this delicate process.

instructions.title: Add the Next Layer
instructions.text: Push the rolled omelette to one side of the pan. Lightly re-grease the empty portion of the pan if needed. Pour another quarter of the egg mixture into the empty space, allowing some to seep underneath the rolled portion. Cook until mostly set.

instructions.title: Continue Rolling and Layering
instructions.text: Once the new layer is mostly set, continue rolling the existing omelette over the fresh egg layer. Repeat this process with the remaining egg mixture, adding new layers and rolling until all the egg mixture is used and you have a thick, multi-layered omelette.

instructions.title: Final Cooking and Slicing
instructions.text: Once fully rolled, cook the Gyeran Mari for another minute or two, gently pressing it down to ensure all layers are cooked through. Remove from the pan and let it cool slightly on a cutting board before slicing into 1-inch thick pieces. Serve warm.

tips: For perfectly even layers, pour the egg mixture through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any remaining egg white strands.
Keep the heat consistently low to medium-low. Too high heat will brown the omelette too quickly and make it difficult to roll without breaking.
If you want to add more fillings like ham or cheese, make sure they are very finely diced or shredded to ensure a smooth roll.
